"META_DATA":
  "Name": "nvfp4_fused_moe"
  "Describe": "Routed NVFP4 mixture-of-experts forward with an explicit block-16 activation\
    \ quantize-dequantize between FC1 and FC2 and a routing-weighted BF16 sum"
  "Source": "KernelSchema@24d2b3d3ca9d4907c4e7efd9607cf78cfb1a52b2:kernel_wiki/aka-cuda-operators-20261030/operators/moe/nvfp4_fused_moe/candidate/solution.py::Model.forward"
  "Version": 5
  "Dispatch":
    "when": "token_count*slot_count > 1536 and ceil_div(token_count*slot_count,128)*(hidden_dim/128)*max(1,intermediate_dim/256)\
      \ >= 3072, with the seven-node chain, large routing preparation, eight-element\
      \ finalize and PDL enabled as selected here; token_count*slot_count > 8192 or\
      \ (token_count*slot_count)*hidden_dim > 32000000 or some ids entry lies in [0,expert_count),\
      \ and the hidden_states payload is not entirely zero in magnitude"
"CONTRACT":
  "Algorithm_requirement":
    "Constant":
      "nvfp4_block":
        "value": 16
        "meaning": "Channels sharing one NVFP4 scale factor"
      "e2m1_max":
        "value": 6
        "meaning": "Largest magnitude of a signed E2M1 code"
      "e4m3_max":
        "value": 448
        "meaning": "Largest finite fp8_e4m3fn magnitude"
    "Input":
      "topk_ids":
        "meaning": "Routing pair (expert ids, route weights) per slot"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "slot": "slot_count"
        "dtype": "tuple(int32, fp32)"
      "hidden_states":
        "meaning": "NVFP4 payload of the token activations, 2 per byte"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "packed_hidden": "hidden_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "hidden_states_scale":
        "meaning": "E4M3 scale per nvfp4_block hidden channels"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "hidden_block": "hidden_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm1_weights":
        "meaning": "Prepared NVFP4 FC1 payload, up and gate rows"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
        - "packed_hidden": "hidden_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "gemm1_weights_scale":
        "meaning": "Prepared FC1 scales, 128x4 tiled"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
        - "hidden_block": "hidden_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm2_weights":
        "meaning": "Prepared NVFP4 FC2 payload"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        - "packed_intermediate": "intermediate_dim/2"
        "dtype": "uint8"
      "gemm2_weights_scale":
        "meaning": "Prepared FC2 scales, 128x4 tiled"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        - "intermediate_block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
        "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
      "gemm1_alpha":
        "meaning": "Per-expert alpha of the FC1 activation"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "range": "[0.5, 2] or 4.0"
      "gemm1_beta":
        "meaning": "Per-expert beta of the FC1 activation"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "range": "[0, 1] or 25.0"
      "gemm1_clamp_limit":
        "meaning": "Per-expert FC1 clamp bound; None disables it"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
        "nullable": true
        "range": "[1, 16]"
      "activation_type":
        "meaning": "Selects one of the two FC1 activation formulas"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
        "range": "3 or 10"
      "routing_bias":
        "meaning": "Router bias, always None; routing is resolved"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "gemm1_bias":
        "meaning": "FC1 bias, absent in the declared domain"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "gemm2_bias":
        "meaning": "FC2 bias, absent in the declared domain"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "output1_scale_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC1 up scale, 1 in the domain and not applied"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
      "output1_scale_gate_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC1 gate scale, 1 in the domain, not applied"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
      "output2_scale_scalar":
        "meaning": "FC2 scale, 1 in the domain and not applied"
        "shape":
        - "expert": "expert_count"
        "dtype": "fp32"
      "num_experts":
        "meaning": "Equal to expert_count; not read by the math"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "top_k":
        "meaning": "Equal to slot_count; not read by the math"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "intermediate_size":
        "meaning": "Equal to intermediate_dim; not read"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "n_group":
        "meaning": "Router group count, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "topk_group":
        "meaning": "Router group selection count, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "local_expert_offset":
        "meaning": "First local expert index, 0 in the domain"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "local_num_experts":
        "meaning": "Equal to expert_count; not read"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "routed_scaling_factor":
        "meaning": "Routed output factor, 1 and not applied"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_float"
      "routing_method_type":
        "meaning": "Router policy id, 0; routing is consumed as is"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "do_finalize":
        "meaning": "Requests the reduction, True and unconditional"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_bool"
      "enable_pdl":
        "meaning": "Launch hint, False; no numerical effect"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_bool"
      "per_token_scale":
        "meaning": "Per-token scale, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "output_buffer":
        "meaning": "Caller-allocated write destination of the result"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        "dtype": "bf16"
      "tune_max_num_tokens":
        "meaning": "Autotuning budget, 8192; not read"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
      "gemm1_lora_delta":
        "meaning": "FC1 LoRA delta, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "valid_hidden_size":
        "meaning": "Hidden padding limit, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "valid_intermediate_size":
        "meaning": "Intermediate padding limit, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "num_fused_shared_experts":
        "meaning": "Fused shared experts, always None"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_none"
      "hidden_states_scale_layout":
        "meaning": "Scale layout tag, 2; not read by the math"
        "shape": []
        "dtype": "python_int"
    "Output":
      "output":
        "meaning": "output_buffer overwritten and returned in a list"
        "shape":
        - "token": "token_count"
        - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
        "dtype": "bf16"
    "Compute":
    - "Name": "Routing"
      "Math": "topk_ids is the pair (ids, scores): ids[t,s] names the expert of route\
        \ slot s of token t and scores[t,s] is its weight, for 0 <= t < token_count\
        \ and 0 <= s < slot_count.\nA route is valid when ids[t,s] is in [0, expert_count);\
        \ an invalid route selects no expert and contributes exactly 0. The construction\
        \ marks a masked or absent route with -1 and zeroes its score.\nSizes come\
        \ from the input shapes. In the declared domain slot_count = 8, token_count\
        \ is in [1, 8192], (hidden_dim, intermediate_dim, expert_count) is one of\
        \ (2048, 768, 128), (4096, 768, 128), (4096, 1536, 128), (7168, 256, 256),\
        \ and both feature sizes are multiples of nvfp4_block, so every scale block\
        \ is complete.\nArithmetic between the declared storage and quantization boundaries\
        \ is FP32, round-to-nearest-even, TF32 disabled; codes and scales enter at\
        \ their exact decoded values.\nNo formula reads the other interface arguments,\
        \ whose entries record the fixed values of the declared domain.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "ids":
          "meaning": "Expert index of each route slot"
          "shape": "ref:topk_ids.shape"
          "dtype": "int32"
        "scores":
          "meaning": "Routing weight of each route slot"
          "shape": "ref:topk_ids.shape"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Nvfp4 payload decode"
      "Math": "e2m1_level(code) for a 4-bit code is level[code mod 8] of level = (0,\
        \ 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6), negated when code >= 8, so code 8 is -0.\nOne\
        \ payload byte carries two consecutive channels of a row: q[j] holds channel\
        \ 2j in its low nibble q[j] mod 16 and channel 2j+1 in its high nibble floor(q[j]\
        \ / 16).\ndecode(q, sf) for a payload q whose last axis has length m/2 and\
        \ a scale sf whose last axis has length m/nvfp4_block:\n  decode(q, sf)[d]\
        \ = e2m1_level(nibble(d)) * fp32(sf[floor(d / nvfp4_block)])   for 0 <= d\
        \ < m\n  nibble(d) = q[floor(d/2)] mod 16 when d is even, floor(q[floor(d/2)]\
        \ / 16) when d is odd\nThe fp8_e4m3fn scale is used as its exact FP32 value\
        \ and a zero scale decodes its whole block to zero. Every axis other than\
        \ the last is independent and keeps its order.\nhidden_value = decode(hidden_states,\
        \ hidden_states_scale) for each token; the hidden-state scales are logical\
        \ row-major and carry no tiling.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "hidden_value":
          "meaning": "Decoded FP32 activation of one token"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Prepared weight layout"
      "Math": "The declared prepared layout stores the expert weight payloads and\
        \ scales out of logical row order. For a prepared tensor with nrow logical\
        \ rows:\n  half_row(l) = 2*l for l < nrow/2 and 2*(l - nrow/2) + 1 for l >=\
        \ nrow/2, applied to gemm1_weights only, whose stored rows interleave the\
        \ up and gate halves; gemm2_weights uses half_row(l) = l\n  row_perm(g) =\
        \ 32*floor(g/32) + 8*(g mod 4) + floor((g mod 32)/4)\n  prepared_row(l) =\
        \ row_perm(half_row(l))\nThe payload row and the scale row of one logical\
        \ row share that index. The weight scale bytes are in addition tiled into\
        \ 128-row by 4-column blocks: reading the stored scale tensor of one expert\
        \ as an (nrow/128, ncol/4, 32, 16) image, where ncol is its scale column count,\
        \ the multiplier of prepared row p and scale column j sits at [floor(p/128),\
        \ floor(j/4), p mod 32, 4*floor((p mod 128)/32) + (j mod 4)]. Every declared\
        \ geometry has nrow a multiple of 128 and ncol a multiple of 4, so the tiling\
        \ carries no padding.\n"
    - "Name": "Decoded expert weights"
      "Math": "w1[e][L,:] = decode over the row prepared_row(L) of gemm1_weights[e]\
        \ and of the un-tiled gemm1_weights_scale[e], for 0 <= L < 2*intermediate_dim,\
        \ so nrow = 2*intermediate_dim. Logical rows below intermediate_dim form the\
        \ up projection and the rest form the gate projection.\nw2[e][L,:] = the same\
        \ decode over gemm2_weights and gemm2_weights_scale, for 0 <= L < hidden_dim,\
        \ so nrow = hidden_dim and half_row(L) = L.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "w1":
          "meaning": "Decoded FC1 weight of one expert, logical rows"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          - "out": "2*intermediate_dim"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
        "w2":
          "meaning": "Decoded FC2 weight of one expert, logical rows"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Fc1 per route"
      "Math": "For every valid route (t,s) with e = ids[t,s]:\n  up[t,s,i]   = sum_{h=0}^{hidden_dim-1}\
        \ hidden_value[t,h] * w1[e,i,h]                    for 0 <= i < intermediate_dim\n\
        \  gate[t,s,i] = sum_{h=0}^{hidden_dim-1} hidden_value[t,h] * w1[e,intermediate_dim+i,h]\n\
        Both are FP32 dot products over the whole hidden dimension, without bias and\
        \ without any output scale factor. up and gate exist only for valid routes;\
        \ an invalid route never reaches FC2 and contributes 0 to the output.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "up":
          "meaning": "FC1 up half of one valid route, pre-activation"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
        "gate":
          "meaning": "FC1 gate half of one valid route, pre-activation"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Generated activation parameters"
      "Math": "The supplied input construction uses activation_type 10 with gemm1_alpha\
        \ = 4 and gemm1_beta = 25; type 3 uses alpha in [0.5,2] and beta in [0,1].\
        \ Each parameter vector is constant across experts. Both branches are retained\
        \ because the dynamic domain specifies SiTU while nine fixed cases construct\
        \ type 3.\n"
    - "Name": "Clamp and activation"
      "Math": "alpha = gemm1_alpha[e] and beta = gemm1_beta[e] are per-expert values\
        \ used exactly.\nIf gemm1_clamp_limit is not None, with limit = gemm1_clamp_limit[e]:\n\
        \  up_c   = clamp(up, -limit, limit)\n  gate_c = min(gate, limit)\nThe gate\
        \ half is bounded from above only and receives no lower bound. If gemm1_clamp_limit\
        \ is None, up_c = up and gate_c = gate.\nIf activation_type = 10:\n  act =\
        \ alpha * tanh(gate_c / alpha) * sigmoid(gate_c) * (beta * tanh(up_c / beta))\n\
        Otherwise, which is activation_type = 3 in the declared domain:\n  act = gate_c\
        \ * sigmoid(alpha * gate_c) * (up_c + beta)\nsigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)),\
        \ tanh is the hyperbolic tangent, and every product and sum is FP32.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act":
          "meaning": "Activated FC1 value of one valid route"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Activation nvfp4 round trip"
      "Math": "A valid route (t,s) quantizes independent groups of nvfp4_block consecutive\
        \ channels, 0 <= b < intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block:\n  peak = max_{0<=u<nvfp4_block}\
        \ abs(act[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u])\n  act_scale[t,s,b] = fp8_e4m3fn(clamp(fp32(peak\
        \ * fp32(1/e2m1_max)), 0, e4m3_max))\n  normalized = act[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u]\
        \ / fp32(act_scale[t,s,b]) when act_scale[t,s,b] > 0, and 0 when it is 0\n\
        \  act_q[t,s,b*nvfp4_block+u] = e2m1_rne(normalized) * fp32(act_scale[t,s,b])\n\
        The reference multiplies by the rounded FP32 reciprocal of e2m1_max. The scale\
        \ cast is round-to-nearest-even after the clamp and read back exactly; a zero\
        \ scale forces its group to zero.\ne2m1_rne(x) keeps the sign of x, rounds\
        \ abs(x) to the nearest value of (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6), takes the level\
        \ with the even code index on a tie, and saturates to 6 when abs(x) > 6.\n\
        This quantize-dequantize is the declared boundary between the activation and\
        \ FC2: FC2 consumes act_q and never act.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act_scale":
          "meaning": "E4M3 scale of one activation block of a route"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
          "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
        "act_q":
          "meaning": "Activation after the NVFP4 round trip"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "intermediate": "intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Fc2 per route"
      "Math": "For every valid route (t,s) with e = ids[t,s] and 0 <= h < hidden_dim:\n\
        \  route_out[t,s,h] = fp32(bf16(sum_{i=0}^{intermediate_dim-1} act_q[t,s,i]\
        \ * w2[e,h,i])) * scores[t,s]\nThe FP32 sum covers the whole intermediate\
        \ dimension, is materialized as BF16 with round-to-nearest-even before the\
        \ routing weight is applied, and the product is formed in FP32. No bias and\
        \ no output scale factor is applied.\nFor a route that selects no expert,\
        \ route_out[t,s,h] = 0 for every h.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "route_out":
          "meaning": "BF16 FC2 result of one route times its weight"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    - "Name": "Routing reduction and output"
      "Math": "For every token t and hidden channel h:\n  acc[t,h] = sum_{s=0}^{slot_count-1}\
        \ route_out[t,s,h]      in FP32, the summation order over routes being unspecified\n\
        \  output[t,h] = bf16(acc[t,h])                              round-to-nearest-even\
        \ into the declared storage dtype\nA token whose slots are all invalid keeps\
        \ acc = 0 and therefore output = 0, which is how empty and fully masked routing\
        \ are answered.\noutput is output_buffer, the same tensor object the caller\
        \ supplied: its incoming values are not read, all token_count*hidden_dim elements\
        \ are overwritten, that object is returned inside a one-element list, and\
        \ no other caller-visible storage changes. The input construction places output_buffer\
        \ inside a larger guarded allocation, so a write outside that view is observable.\
        \ Buffers an implementation keeps for itself are not outputs.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "acc":
          "meaning": "FP32 sum of the route contributions of a token"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
    "Golden_reference":
      "Source": "KernelSchema@24d2b3d3ca9d4907c4e7efd9607cf78cfb1a52b2:kernel_wiki/aka-cuda-operators-20261030/operators/moe/nvfp4_fused_moe/problem/reference.py::Model.forward"
      "Tolerance":
        "output": "Source-only atol=.01 rtol=.05; default mismatch=0; output-write\
          \ mismatch=.001 rel_l2=.01"
      "Gap": "Comparator formulas and return/writeback mapping absent; source activation\
        \ declarations differ"
  "Hardware_specification":
    "Device": null
    "Architecture": null
    "Execution":
      "thread": "Single instruction lane of a warp holding its own registers; the\
        \ fixed implementation sizes per-thread payload staging at this level"
      "warp": "32 threads issued together inside one CTA; the fixed implementation\
        \ splits staging, tensor-core issue and epilogue roles across warps of the\
        \ same CTA"
      "cta": "Thread block of one or more warps that runs on a single SM for its lifetime\
        \ and owns one shared-memory allocation"
      "sm": "Streaming multiprocessor hosting the resident CTAs of a grid together\
        \ with their shared memory and registers"
      "grid": "The CTAs of one kernel launch, distributed over the SMs of the device,\
        \ with no ordering guaranteed between them"
    "Feature":
      "mechanism": null
    "Stack":
      "Language": null
      "Toolchain": null

      "Hardware": null

"REALIZATION":
  "Require":
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1.MMA"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2.MMA"
    "Choice": "tcgen05.mma kind::mxf4nvf4 with block_scale scale_vec::4X over shared-memory\
      \ operands and a TMEM accumulator, the scale blocks staged into TMEM by tcgen05.cp\
      \ 32x128b.warpx4 in the layout that instruction requires"
    "Reason": "The design keeps both operands packed and applies the E4M3 block scales\
      \ inside the product; no other primitive gives that numeric path or that scale\
      \ placement"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1.MMA"
    "Choice": "One m128n128k64 product per kset covering the fused up and gate columns,\
      \ not a pair of 64-column products"
    "Reason": "The B image is staged as 128 contiguous rows, so the fused form halves\
      \ the issuer's serial chain per stage"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Work_schedule::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Work_schedule::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "Multi-dimensional TMA boxes whose row algebra equals the Contract's\
      \ prepared_row, encoded through cuTensorMapEncodeTiled reached from cudart;\
      \ refuse the launch when a map cannot be encoded"
    "Reason": "These steps have no cp.async staging path, so an unencodable operand\
      \ map has no correct fallback and must fail instead"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2.EPI"
    "Choice": "A byte-view bulk tensor store map over rout, 64 bytes by 32 rows, requiring\
      \ hidden_dim >= 64 and route_capacity >= 32; refuse the launch without it"
    "Reason": "The bulk drain is the only store path of a full quadrant, and a partial\
      \ quadrant must keep the masked store"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Work_schedule::Flow.Launch"
    "Choice": "griddepcontrol.wait at every node entry and griddepcontrol.launch_dependents\
      \ from one warp, with the programmatic serialization attribute on each launch"
    "Reason": "This is what makes launch_ready earlier than kernel_done while keeping\
      \ the handoff visibility the Flow declares"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "mbarrier phase parity for the ring and item handshakes, the stage barrier\
      \ counting 34 arrivals plus the announced bytes, and tcgen05.commit for cumulative\
      \ retirement"
    "Reason": "The producers and the issuer never meet at a block barrier, so slot\
      \ reuse and accumulator handover rest on these counts"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "Two resident CTAs per sm, with 256 allocated TMEM columns and 106640\
      \ bytes of dynamic shared memory for GEMM1 and 114960 for GEMM2"
    "Reason": "The ring, scale and sink regions the roles use are sized to that residency,\
      \ and a wider TMEM allocation would halve it"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_scale"
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_payload"
    "Choice": "Hardware round-to-nearest-even saturating conversions, to fp8_e4m3fn\
      \ for the group scale and to E2M1 for the codes"
    "Reason": "The rounding and saturation points declared for the quantize step are\
      \ those of these conversions, not of a software table"
  "Forbid":
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2.MMA"
    "Choice": "A second 128-column accumulator alternating by item parity to delete\
      \ this role's drain wait at the item boundary"
    "Reason": "At BN=128 it needs 512 TMEM columns and drops residency to one CTA\
      \ per sm; the source measured that form at 0.906x and left a BN=64 variant unpriced"
"DESIGN":
  "Math_reshape":
    "Thesis": "Both operands stay packed NVFP4 and the tensor core applies the block-16\
      \ scales, so no decoded array exists. Routes are grouped per expert to make\
      \ every tile's rows contiguous, and the FC1 epilogue quantizes with reciprocal\
      \ and approximate-function rounding"
    "Rewrite":
    - "Name": "Route grouping and padding"
      "Math": "A route (t,s) is valid as in Contract; route_count counts them. counts[e]\
        \ counts expert e and offs is its exclusive prefix, offs[expert_count] = route_count.\n\
        route_position maps valid routes onto [0,route_count), expert e owning [offs[e],offs[e]+counts[e]);\
        \ order within an expert is an arbitrary permutation.\nroute_of[t,s] = route_position(t,s),\
        \ or -1 when invalid; route_token[r], route_slot[r], route_expert[r] invert\
        \ it.\ntile_offsets is the exclusive prefix of ceil(counts[e]/bm), tile_count\
        \ = tile_offsets[expert_count], tile_expert[j] owns j, tile_first[j] = (j-tile_offsets[tile_expert[j]])*bm.\n\
        Tile j starts at offs[tile_expert[j]]+tile_first[j]. Padding can overlap later\
        \ experts' valid rows or the unwritten tail. Payload boxes zero-fill past\
        \ route_capacity; scales repeat the first valid row. Padding accumulator lanes\
        \ are discarded; neither encoding traps.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "route_count":
          "meaning": "Number of valid routes"
        "route_capacity":
          "meaning": "Allocated rows of route-indexed buffers"
          "value": "token_count*slot_count"
        "bm":
          "meaning": "Route rows in one tile"
          "binding": "bind:DESIGN.Work_schedule::bm"
        "counts":
          "meaning": "Valid routes per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "offs":
          "meaning": "Exclusive route prefix per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count+1"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_count":
          "meaning": "Number of nonempty route tiles"
        "tile_bound":
          "meaning": "Upper bound on the route tile count"
          "value": "ceil_div(route_capacity,bm) + min(expert_count,route_capacity)"
        "tile_offsets":
          "meaning": "Exclusive tile prefix per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count+1"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_expert":
          "meaning": "Expert owning each route tile"
          "shape":
          - "tile": "tile_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_first":
          "meaning": "First route of a tile inside its expert"
          "shape":
          - "tile": "tile_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_of":
          "meaning": "Position of each route slot"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_token":
          "meaning": "Token of a positioned route; unread here"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_slot":
          "meaning": "Slot of a positioned route; unread here"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_expert":
          "meaning": "Expert of a positioned route; unread here"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Evaluate every route from its own token row, fetching the expert\
          \ weights per route"
        "Gain": "One expert's weights serve a contiguous run of up to bm routes, addressed\
          \ as offsets of one buffer"
        "Cost": "0 -> about 16*route_capacity bytes of index arrays per call, plus\
          \ the per-expert and per-tile offsets"
    - "Name": "Route-ordered activation operand"
      "Math": "For every token t and every slot s whose route_of[t,s] = r is not -1:\n\
        \  gathered_payload[r,:] = hidden_states[t,:] and gathered_scale[r,:] = hidden_states_scale[t,:]\n\
        a byte-exact copy with no decode and no rescale, so decode(gathered_payload[r],\
        \ gathered_scale[r]) = hidden_value[t] by the Contract's decode. One token\
        \ row is copied to each of its valid routes, and a token with no valid route\
        \ is not read.\nRows r >= route_count are never written and keep whatever\
        \ the buffer held before.\nThe gathered payload and scales occupy disjoint\
        \ regions of one byte allocation: payload first, of size route_capacity*hidden_dim/2,\
        \ then route_capacity*hidden_dim/16 scale bytes.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "gathered_payload":
          "meaning": "Activation payload in route order"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "packed_hidden": "hidden_dim/2"
          "dtype": "uint8"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "gathered_scale":
          "meaning": "Activation scales in route order"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "hidden_block": "hidden_dim/nvfp4_block"
          "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "FC1 gathers the 128 scattered token rows of a tile at every stage"
        "Gain": "Per stage one contiguous 128-row box replaces 32 four-row gathers,\
          \ and the copy runs once per call"
        "Cost": "0 -> route_capacity*(hidden_dim/2 + hidden_dim/16) bytes written\
          \ once, re-read intermediate_dim/64 times"
    - "Name": "Block-scaled packed product"
      "Math": "Neither operand is decoded. For packed codes ac, bc and E4M3 scales\
        \ as, bs over a reduction length L that is a multiple of nvfp4_block, with\
        \ kb = floor(k/nvfp4_block):\n  bsprod(ac,as,bc,bs)[m,n] = sum32 over kb ascending\
        \ of fp32(as[m,kb]) * fp32(bs[n,kb]) * sum_{u=0}^{nvfp4_block-1} e2m1(ac[m,kb*nvfp4_block+u])\
        \ * e2m1(bc[n,kb*nvfp4_block+u])\nthe FP32 accumulator being zeroed before\
        \ kb = 0. The outer sum advances nvfp4_block*4 channels per tensor-core instruction,\
        \ and the inner sum with its two scale products is formed inside that instruction.\n\
        FC1: for the routes r of tile j and the channels n of its n-tile, fc1_up[r,n]\
        \ and fc1_gate[r,n] are bsprod of row r of (gathered_payload, gathered_scale)\
        \ against the prepared rows n and intermediate_dim+n of expert tile_expert[j]\
        \ in (gemm1_weights, gemm1_weights_scale), with L = hidden_dim. For the (t,s)\
        \ with route_of[t,s] = r they are the Contract's up[t,s,n] and gate[t,s,n],\
        \ and they exist only as one item's accumulator.\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "FP32 accumulator, ascending block order, zeroed at the item's\
          \ first group; intra-instruction grouping and rounding are the tensor core's\
          \ own"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Decode both operands to BF16 and run a BF16 tensor-core product\
          \ of the same tiles"
        "Gain": "Operand bytes per element 2 -> 9/16 including scales, and the BF16\
          \ decode pass is removed"
        "Cost": "Tensor-core grouping and rounding differ from the reference FP32\
          \ dot products; no domain-wide numerical bound is supplied"
    - "Name": "Clamp, activation and NVFP4 quantize"
      "Math": "For route r of tile j, e = tile_expert[j]; alpha, beta and optional\
        \ limit are the Contract's per-expert parameters. Apply its clamp to fc1_up/fc1_gate,\
        \ giving up_c/gate_c.\n  type 3: act = (gate_c * sig(gate_c,fp32(alpha*L2E)))\
        \ * (up_c + beta)\n  type 10: act = ((alpha*tan_pre(gate_c,k_gu))*sig(gate_c,L2E))*(beta*tan_pre(up_c,k_uu))\n\
        \  k_gu = fp32(rcp_rn(alpha)*fp32(2*L2E)); k_uu = fp32(rcp_rn(beta)*fp32(2*L2E))\n\
        \  sig(x,k) = rcp_approx(1 + exp2_approx_ftz(fp32(x*k))); tan_pre(x,k) = fma32(sig(x,k),2,-1);\
        \ L2E = fp32(-1.44269504)\nFor each nvfp4_block-channel group b, peak = max\
        \ abs(act) over its channels:\n  act_scale[r,b] = fp8_e4m3fn(min(peak*fp32(1/e2m1_max),e4m3_max)),\
        \ saturating\n  act_code = e2m1_rne(act*rcp_rn(max(fp32(act_scale[r,b]),2^-126))),\
        \ saturating\nact_payload packs two codes per byte, even channel low; code\
        \ times scale is the dequantized fc2 operand.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act_scale":
          "meaning": "E4M3 scale of one activation block"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
          "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "act_payload":
          "meaning": "E2M1 activation codes at two per byte"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "packed": "intermediate_dim/2"
          "dtype": "uint8"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Approx": "sig and tan_pre use ex2.approx.ftz and rcp.approx with folded prescales;\
          \ source comments report small sampled errors, not a domain-wide bound"
        "Accumulate": "peak is an order-free max tree; the quantize step multiplies\
          \ by rcp_rn of the scale instead of dividing, and 1/e2m1_max is a rounded\
          \ constant"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Materialize the activated FC1 value as FP32 and quantize it in\
          \ a separate pass"
        "Gain": "Activation bytes 4 -> 9/16 per element and no second pass over them"
        "Cost": "The reciprocal quantize multiply and the approximate activation add\
          \ error the Contract's exact forms do not"
    - "Name": "Fc2 product and per-route BF16"
      "Math": "fc2[r,h] = bsprod of row r of (act_payload, act_scale) against the\
        \ prepared row h of expert tile_expert[j] in (gemm2_weights, gemm2_weights_scale),\
        \ with L = intermediate_dim, for the routes r of tile j. For the (t,s) with\
        \ route_of[t,s] = r it is the Contract's inner sum of that route, because\
        \ act_code*fp32(act_scale) is act_q.\nrout[r,h] = bf16(fc2[r,h]), round to\
        \ nearest even, is materialized for every valid route and is what the routing\
        \ reduction consumes; fc2 itself is never stored.\nA padding row can read\
        \ a later expert's valid act_payload row, an unwritten tail row, or zero fill\
        \ beyond route_capacity. Its scales repeat this tile's first valid row. GEMM2\
        \ discards that row's result; it never overwrites a later expert's rout row.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "rout":
          "meaning": "Per-route FC2 result as BF16"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "bf16"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Keep each route's FC2 result in FP32, or reduce routes into the\
          \ token output where they are produced"
        "Gain": "Route result bytes 4 -> 2 per element"
        "Cost": "One extra BF16 rounding per element, and route_capacity*hidden_dim*2\
          \ bytes written then re-read"
    - "Name": "Routing-weighted output reduction"
      "Math": "For every token t and hidden channel h:\n  acc[t,h] = the sum over\
        \ s ascending of fma32(fp32(rout[route_of[t,s],h]), scores[t,s], partial),\
        \ from 0\nskipping every s whose route_of[t,s] is -1, so an invalid route\
        \ contributes exactly 0; output[t,h] = bf16(acc[t,h]).\nThese are the Contract's\
        \ acc and output with the route sum fixed to ascending slot order, which the\
        \ Contract leaves unspecified. fp32(x) is the exact widening of a BF16 value,\
        \ and output is written for every (t,h) whether or not any route is valid.\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "Each route term is one fma32 of the widened BF16 value and\
          \ its score, so the product is not rounded before the running sum"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Accumulate the score-weighted route results into the output atomically,\
          \ as the reference does"
        "Gain": "A fixed ascending slot order per element, one BF16 rounding, and\
          \ no read-modify-write of output"
        "Cost": "rout is read slot_count times per token instead of being reduced\
          \ where it is produced"
  "Work_schedule":
    "Thesis": "One submission per pipeline node, each permitted to launch by its predecessor\
      \ rather than waiting for it to finish, so node preambles overlap. Both GEMMs\
      \ read one route-tile map through a persistent capped grid that only partitions\
      \ the item space"
    "Step":
      "COUNT":
        "Describe": "Count the valid routes of every expert into a per-block shared\
          \ histogram and add it into the global per-expert totals"
        "Decomposition":
          "Partition":
            "route_chunk":
              "meaning": "Contiguous slice of the flat route list"
              "size": "token_count*slot_count"
              "tile": 256
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "counts":
                "meaning": "This slice's per-expert route counts"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
            "Tile_reduction":
              "dimension": "route_chunk"
              "input": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::counts"
              "output": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::counts"
              "method": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::Route grouping and padding"
        "Mapping":
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "ceil_div(token_count*slot_count, 256)"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "One thread per route of the slice; each block publishes one\
            \ global atomic per expert it saw, so counts is a sum over blocks"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "route_chunk"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "SCAN_TILES":
        "Describe": "Scan the expert counts into route and tile offsets and write\
          \ the tile map naming each tile's expert and first route"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "Tiles cut each expert's run into ceil(counts[e]/bm) blocks\
            \ of bm rows; the tile searches run from the shared tile offsets"
          "Partition": {}
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "offs":
                "meaning": "Exclusive route prefix per expert"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count+1"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_offsets":
                "meaning": "Exclusive tile prefix per expert"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count+1"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_expert":
                "meaning": "Expert owning each route tile"
                "shape":
                - "tile": "tile_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_first":
                "meaning": "First route of a tile inside its expert"
                "shape":
                - "tile": "tile_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One block of 1024 threads; the two-level shuffle scan and every\
            \ tile search stay in shared memory"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": 1
        "Schedule":
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": 0
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "SCATTER":
        "Describe": "Give every route its position inside its expert's run and publish\
          \ the route tuple in both directions"
        "Decomposition":
          "Partition":
            "route_chunk":
              "meaning": "Contiguous slice of the flat route list"
              "size": "token_count*slot_count"
              "tile": 256
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "route_of":
                "meaning": "Position of each route slot"
                "shape":
                - "token": "token_count"
                - "slot": "slot_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_token":
                "meaning": "Token of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_slot":
                "meaning": "Slot of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_expert":
                "meaning": "Expert of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
        "Mapping":
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "ceil_div(token_count*slot_count, 256)"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "One global fill atomic per block and expert reserves a contiguous\
            \ interval; a shared rank takes the slot, so within-expert order is arrival\
            \ order"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "route_chunk"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "GATHER":
        "Describe": "Copy each token's payload and scale bytes into the route-ordered\
          \ rows of its routes; the step exits when no route is valid"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "The first hidden_dim/32 chunks of a token are payload, the\
            \ rest are scales; a token with no valid route is skipped without a read"
          "Partition":
            "chunk_item":
              "meaning": "One 16-byte chunk of a token row"
              "size": "token_count*(hidden_dim/32 + hidden_dim/256)"
              "tile": 128
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "gathered_payload":
                "meaning": "Payload chunks this slice copies"
                "shape":
                - "item": 128
                - "byte": 16
                "dtype": "uint8"
              "gathered_scale":
                "meaning": "Scale chunks this slice copies"
                "shape":
                - "item": 128
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One thread per item; the cap makes the slices grid-stride instead\
            \ of launching one block per item"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "min(ceil_div(token_count*(hidden_dim/32 + hidden_dim/256),\
            \ 128), 1184)"
        "Schedule":
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "chunk_item"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "stride": "worker_count"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "GEMM1":
        "Describe": "Multiply each route tile's gathered activation by its expert's\
          \ FC1 weight and emit the clamped, activated and quantized intermediate"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "bm = 128 route rows per tile; a stage advances 256 hidden channels,\
            \ and the two 64-row halves up and gate form one 128-row operand"
          "Partition":
            "tile":
              "meaning": "One existing route tile"
              "size": "tile_count"
              "tile": 1
              "range":
              - 0
              - "tile_bound"
            "n_tile":
              "meaning": "Block of intermediate channels"
              "size": "intermediate_dim"
              "tile": 64
          "Worktile":
            "Iteration":
              "a_payload":
                "meaning": "Gathered activation payload of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "a_scale":
                "meaning": "Gathered activation scales of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_payload":
                "meaning": "FC1 payload of 128 prepared rows; up then gate"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_scale":
                "meaning": "FC1 scales of those rows in one fused image"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "act_payload":
                "meaning": "Quantized codes of the tile's routes"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "byte": 32
                "dtype": "uint8"
              "act_scale":
                "meaning": "Group scales of the tile's routes"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "block": 4
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "resident_cap is two CTAs per sm of the device; the capped grid\
            \ only partitions items and never changes which items run"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "(intermediate_dim/64)*min(tile_bound, max(1, floor(resident_cap/(intermediate_dim/64))))"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "Items are numbered tile*(intermediate_dim/64) + n_tile and\
            \ bounded by the device tile_count, so a worker past it takes no item"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "n_tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "stride": "worker_count"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "GEMM2":
        "Describe": "Multiply each route tile's packed activation by its expert's\
          \ FC2 weight and materialize every route's result as BF16"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "bm = 128 route rows per tile, the same tiles GEMM1 used; a\
            \ stage advances 256 intermediate channels of one 128-column operand"
          "Partition":
            "tile":
              "meaning": "One existing route tile"
              "size": "tile_count"
              "tile": 1
              "range":
              - 0
              - "tile_bound"
            "n_tile":
              "meaning": "Block of hidden channels"
              "size": "hidden_dim"
              "tile": 128
          "Worktile":
            "Iteration":
              "a_payload":
                "meaning": "Packed activation payload of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "a_scale":
                "meaning": "Activation group scales of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_payload":
                "meaning": "FC2 payload of 128 prepared rows"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_scale":
                "meaning": "FC2 scales of those prepared rows"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "rout":
                "meaning": "BF16 route results of the tile"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "hidden": 128
                "dtype": "bf16"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "resident_cap is two CTAs per sm of the device; the capped grid\
            \ only partitions items and never changes which items run"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "(hidden_dim/128)*min(tile_bound, max(1, floor(resident_cap/(hidden_dim/128))))"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "Items are numbered tile*(hidden_dim/128) + n_tile and bounded\
            \ by the device tile_count, so a worker past it takes no item"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "n_tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "stride": "worker_count"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "FINALIZE":
        "Describe": "Sum each token's routed BF16 results weighted by their routing\
          \ scores and write that token's output row"
        "Decomposition":
          "Partition":
            "token":
              "meaning": "One output row"
              "size": "token_count"
              "tile": 1
            "hidden_block":
              "meaning": "Block of hidden channels"
              "size": "hidden_dim"
              "tile": 1024
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "output":
                "meaning": "This token's channels in the block"
                "shape":
                - "hidden": 1024
                "dtype": "ref:CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement::output.dtype"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One thread per 8-channel chunk of the block; a thread whose\
            \ chunk passes hidden_dim/8 has no work"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1

  "Tile_pipeline":
    "Thesis": "Seven warps split into two operand producers, one tensor-core issuer\
      \ and four epilogue warps, coupled only by mbarriers. A three-deep payload ring\
      \ and a two-deep scale ring are waited on separately, and one accumulator is\
      \ handed over per item"
    "Step":
      "COUNT":
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Histogram this block's route slice in shared memory and\
                \ add it into the global expert counts"
              "Member": "warp[0:8]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "histogram":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Zero a shared expert histogram, add this slice's\
                      \ valid ids, then one global atomic add per nonzero expert into\
                      \ counts"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "compute:histogram"
      "SCAN_TILES":
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Scan the expert counts into route and tile offsets, then\
                \ write the tile map"
              "Member": "warp[0:32]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "scan":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Two-level shuffle scan of counts and of ceil(counts[e]/bm)\
                      \ over 32 warps, publishing offs and tile_offsets; done covers\
                      \ the block rendezvous"
                  "tile_map":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Search the shared tile offsets for each tile's expert\
                      \ and first route, writing tile_expert and tile_first"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "compute:scan"
            - "compute:tile_map"
      "SCATTER":
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Assign each route of this block's slice its position and\
                \ publish the route tuple"
              "Member": "warp[0:8]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "slice_counts":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Count this block's routes per expert in shared memory;\
                      \ done covers the block rendezvous that closes the count"
                  "reserve":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One global atomic per expert seen adds this block's\
                      \ count to the fill counter zeroed with counts, giving the block's\
                      \ base; done covers the rendezvous"
                  "publish":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take the slot from a shared per-expert rank and write\
                      \ route_token, route_slot, route_expert and route_of, or -1\
                      \ for an invalid route"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "compute:slice_counts"
            - "compute:reserve"
            - "compute:publish"
      "GATHER":
        "Index":
          "w":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's slices"
            "definition": "worktile"
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Copy the payload and scale chunks of this slice into the\
                \ route-ordered operand rows"
              "Member": "warp[0:4]"
              "Using_verb":
                "load":
                  "token_chunk":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each thread reads the 16 bytes of one item of slice\
                      \ w from hidden_states or hidden_states_scale, skipping items\
                      \ whose token has no valid route"
                "store":
                  "route_chunks":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Each thread writes its 16 bytes to the same chunk\
                      \ offset of every route row of that token, at most slot_count\
                      \ rows"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "if(route_count > 0)":
              - "for(w)":
                - "load:token_chunk(w)"
                - "store:route_chunks(w)"
      "GEMM1":
        "Index":
          "t":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's items"
            "definition": "worktile"
          "ks":
            "meaning": "k stage inside one item"
            "definition":
            - 0
            - "hidden_dim/256"
          "g":
            "meaning": "Stage ordinal across items"
            "definition":
              "flatten":
              - "t"
              - "ks"
        "Storage":
          "a_ring":
            "meaning": "Gathered activation payload stages"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "a_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "b_ring":
            "meaning": "FC1 payload stages; up rows then gate rows"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "b_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "sfa_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged activation scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "a_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sfb_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged fused weight scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "b_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sf_tmem":
            "meaning": "Tensor-core scale columns of one stage"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "tmem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "column": 32
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 32768
            "view":
              "sf_a(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 0
                  - 16
              "sf_b(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 16
                  - 32
          "accumulator":
            "meaning": "FP32 up and gate product of one item"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "tmem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "column": 128
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 65536
          "sf_prefetch":
            "meaning": "Lookahead register set of activation scale rows"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "register"
            "shape":
            - "lane": 32
            - "row": 4
            - "byte": 16
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "sf_regs(ks)":
                "slot_index": "ks%2"
        "Role":
          "PRODA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage the activation scale bytes of every stage into the\
                \ scale ring one stage ahead of their use"
              "Member": "warp[0:1]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Thread 0 initializes the ring and item barriers with\
                      \ their arrival counts and warp 0 allocates the TMEM columns;\
                      \ done covers the CTA rendezvous"
                  "sfa_stage":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Store the register set into the sfa slot and fence\
                      \ it, issue the next stage's load unless this is the item's\
                      \ last, then arrive on the stage barrier"
                "load":
                  "sf_rows":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Prime both sf_prefetch sets from gathered_scale,\
                      \ 16 bytes per row for the first two stages; padding rows repeat\
                      \ the tile's first valid scale row"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfa slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
                "release":
                  "tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Warp 0 returns the allocated TMEM columns once the\
                      \ retire rendezvous has closed every role's reads"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "compute:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "load:sf_rows(t)"
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "compute:sfa_stage(g)"
              - "await:retire"
              - "release:tmem"
            "Waiting":
              "Released":
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
              - "{issue release:tmem} ← [{done PRODB::await:retire}, {done MMA::await:retire},\
                \ {done EPI::await:retire}]"
          "PRODB":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage each stage's operand payloads by bulk tensor copy\
                \ and its weight scales by async byte copies"
              "Member": "warp[1:2]"
              "Using_verb":
                "load":
                  "a_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 arms the stage barrier with both operands'\
                      \ byte count and issues one 128-row box from gathered_payload,\
                      \ padding rows included"
                  "b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 issues two 64-row boxes over the prepared\
                      \ FC1 weight of tile_expert, the up half then the gate half,\
                      \ into one b_ring slot"
                  "b_scale":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "All 32 lanes copy this stage's weight scale bytes\
                      \ into the sfb slot and arm their arrival on the stage barrier;\
                      \ done covers the staged bytes"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "payload_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core products of stage g-3\
                      \ have read the payload slots that g reuses"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfb slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 3)":
                    - "await:payload_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:a_payload(g)"
                  - "load:b_payload(g)"
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:b_scale(g)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:payload_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-3)}]"
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
          "MMA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Copy each stage's scales into TMEM and issue the fused\
                \ block-scaled products; hoist_enabled is route_capacity >= 16*expert_count"
              "Member": "warp[2:3]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "sf_tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One elected lane copies this stage's activation and\
                      \ weight scale blocks from shared memory into the sf_tmem columns\
                      \ of slot g%2"
                "matmul":
                  "a_payload@b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_ordered"
                    "describe": "Four products of a_ring g%3, b_ring g%3 with sf_a(g),\
                      \ sf_b(g); the item's first writes the accumulator without reading\
                      \ the prior value, the rest add"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "stage_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the stage barrier of g has both operand\
                      \ payloads, both scale blocks and all producer arrivals"
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until all four epilogue warps have released\
                      \ the accumulator of item t-1, so this item may overwrite it"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "stage_retired":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit all products issued so far; the arrival retires\
                      \ stage g, freeing its payload slot and, cumulatively, its scale\
                      \ slot"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit at the item's end; the arrival means every\
                      \ product of item t has retired and the accumulator is readable"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(ks == 0 and t > 0 and hoist_enabled)":
                    - "await:stage_full(g)"
                    - "compute:sf_tmem(g)"
                  - "if(ks == 0 and t > 0)":
                    - "await:accumulator_free(t)"
                  - "if(ks > 0 or t == 0 or not hoist_enabled)":
                    - "await:stage_full(g)"
                    - "compute:sf_tmem(g)"
                  - "matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)"
                  - "signal:stage_retired(g)"
                - "signal:accumulator_full(t)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              - "{done await:stage_full(g)} ← [{done PRODA::compute:sfa_stage(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:a_payload(g)}, {done PRODB::load:b_payload(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:b_scale(g)}]"
              - "{done signal:stage_retired(g)} ← [{done matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:accumulator_free(t)} ← [{done EPI::signal:accumulator_free(t-1)}]"
          "EPI":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Drain the item's accumulator by row quadrant and write\
                \ the quantized activation of the valid routes"
              "Member": "warp[3:7]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "act_qdq":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Clamp, activate and quantize this chunk's 32 channels\
                      \ in 16-channel groups by the Math_reshape step, holding codes\
                      \ and scale bytes in registers"
                "load":
                  "tmem_up":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Read 32 accumulator columns of the up half for this\
                      \ warp's 32 rows into registers"
                  "tmem_gate":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Read the matching 32 columns of the gate half into\
                      \ registers"
                "store":
                  "act_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Write the 16 payload bytes of each lane's route,\
                      \ lanes at or past the tile's valid route count writing nothing"
                  "act_scale":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Write the four scale bytes covering both chunks of\
                      \ this route and n-tile once, from the same lane mask"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the products of item t have retired and\
                      \ the accumulator is readable by all four warps"
                  "tmem_drain":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait for this chunk's two 32-column accumulator reads,\
                      \ the up half and the gate half, issued back to back"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each of the four warps arrives once its last chunk's\
                      \ accumulator reads have retired; the stores may still be in\
                      \ flight"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "await:accumulator_full(t)"
                - "for(c=0:2)":
                  - "load:tmem_up(t,c)"
                  - "load:tmem_gate(t,c)"
                  - "await:tmem_drain(t,c)"
                  - "if(c == 1)":
                    - "signal:accumulator_free(t)"
                  - "compute:act_qdq(t,c)"
                  - "store:act_payload(t,c)"
                  - "if(c == 1)":
                    - "store:act_scale(t)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              - "{done await:accumulator_full(t)} ← [{done MMA::signal:accumulator_full(t)}]"
              - "{done await:tmem_drain(t,c)} ← [{done load:tmem_up(t,c)}, {done load:tmem_gate(t,c)}]"
      "GEMM2":
        "Index":
          "t":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's items"
            "definition": "worktile"
          "ks":
            "meaning": "k stage inside one item"
            "definition":
            - 0
            - "intermediate_dim/256"
          "g":
            "meaning": "Stage ordinal across items"
            "definition":
              "flatten":
              - "t"
              - "ks"
        "Storage":
          "a_ring":
            "meaning": "Packed activation payload stages"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "a_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "b_ring":
            "meaning": "FC2 payload stages"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "b_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "sfa_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged activation scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "a_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sfb_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged weight scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":

            "meaning": "Tensor-core scale columns of one stage"

            "view":

                  - 16

          "accumulator":
            "meaning": "FP32 hidden product of one item"

            "dtype": "fp32"

          "sf_prefetch":
            "meaning": "Lookahead register set of activation scale rows"
            "depth": 2

            "meaning": "Quadrant staging image of one drain chunk"
